note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a MAD 27-29; A06b MAD 27-29; L05 MAD 42-44, 47): ordinary naturalisation after 5 years' residence; no renunciation of other citizenships required; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given. Citizenship at birth is read from the same dataset's 2024 coding of modes A01a (descent, born in country: Generally applicable provision), A01b (descent, born abroad: Generally applicable provision), A02a (birth in country: No provision) and A02b (birth in country to a parent born there: No provision), as its codebook (RSC/GLOBALCIT 2025/01, sections 3.2.1a to 3.2.2b) defines them: not by birth in the territory alone (provisions for foundlings and children otherwise stateless, modes A03a and A03b, aren't held by the form); by descent from either parent, with no further limit on a child born abroad. Changes to the law at birth after 1 January 2024 weren't checked for this file. On 2026-11-03 the primary was read: Nationalité, Mission permanente de Madagascar à Genève (Ministère des Affaires étrangères, diplomatie.gov.mg), quoting art. 27 of the Ordonnance n° 60-064 du 22 juillet 1960. It confirmed the years of residence and renunciation. It was silent on loss on taking another citizenship, birth in the territory and descent, which still rest on the sources above, re-read that day and found the same. The mission quotes art. 27 of Ordonnance 60-064; Loi 2016-038, which holds the rules at birth and on loss, wasn't read.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Madagascar, 2024
sources.said: Person has been habitually resident for 5 years. ... n.a. ... Person voluntarily acquires another citizenship. Person is subject to military service for 15 years after and the loss is subject to authorisation by decree. Or person is a woman who marries a foreigner, lives outside Madagascar, and acquires citizenship of the husband automatically. ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born in Madagascar to a citizen ... Generally applicable provision ... Person is born to a parent who is a citizen. ... No provision ... No provision

sources.title: Nationalité, Mission permanente de Madagascar à Genève (Ministère des Affaires étrangères, diplomatie.gov.mg), quoting art. 27 of the Ordonnance n° 60-064 du 22 juillet 1960
sources.said: Au-delà de vingt et un ans l'intéressé devra demander la naturalisation conformément aux dispositions de l'ordonnance n° 60-064 du 22 juillet 1960 . Art.27 : « La naturalisation ne pourra être accordée qu'aux étrangers remplissant les conditions suivantes : - Avoir dix-huit ans révolus - Etre sain d'esprit - Ne pas présenter de danger pour la collectivité. ... - Avoir eu sa résidence principale à Madagascar pendant cinq années précédant le dépôt de la demande et avoir conservée ladite résidence au moment de la signature du décret de naturalisation (les personnes nées de mère malgache peuvent être dispensées de cette condition); - Justifier de son assimilation à la Communauté malgache, notamment par une connaissance suffisante, selon sa condition , de la langue malgache »
